summary: Backend: 39/39 pytest tests pass against the new device-UUID Bearer auth model (auto-create user, PATCH /auth/me completeness rules, name/picture propagation to groups/participants, groups CRUD, public list/detail, mine, join dedup + capacity, owner-cannot-leave, delete cascades messages, message participant gating, legacy Firebase endpoints all 404). Frontend: onboarding screen renders on first web load without any login UI, device id is generated (dev_<hex32>) and stored under @groupup/device_id, PATCH /auth/me works from the browser, profile tab shows the entered name plus 'ID: dev_...' (NO email field), 'Reimposta account' generates a new device id and re-opens onboarding, and subsequent loads with a complete profile skip onboarding. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: (tabs)/_layout.tsx gates tabs behind user.profile_complete, so after the lightweight onboarding (name only) the user is force-redirected to /profile-edit?mode=onboarding and can NEVER enter the tabs until picture+gender+age are also filled — this contradicts the review requirement 'Submitting the name on onboarding routes to the tabs (feed)'.

minor.issue: firebase-admin may still be listed in backend/requirements.txt (harmless, but dead dependency — remove to reduce install size).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: `if (!user.profile_complete) return <Redirect href="/profile-edit?mode=onboarding" />;` (line 13) forces the user through the full profile-edit screen after the lightweight name-only onboarding. Because backend `profile_complete` requires name AND gender AND age AND picture, the promised zero-friction flow is broken — you cannot reach the tabs by just entering a name. Either drop this gate (only gate on `!user.name`), or change backend `profile_complete` to be name-only.

Dead redirect: line 12 still points to `/login` (`<Redirect href="/login" />`), but the /login route was removed with Firebase. If `user` ever becomes null the app would 404. Replace with `<Redirect href="/onboarding" />` or `<Redirect href="/" />`.

integration_issues.issue: onboarding.tsx submits name via PATCH /auth/me and calls router.replace('/(tabs)'), but the (tabs) layout immediately bounces back to /profile-edit?mode=onboarding because profile_complete is false. Reproduced end-to-end in the web preview.

issues: React Native Web console warnings: `shadow*` style props deprecated (should be `boxShadow`); `props.pointerEvents` deprecated (should be `style.pointerEvents`). Non-blocking but noisy — same warnings already flagged in iteration_5.

react_native_issues.issue: `expo-secure-store` still declared in app.json plugins although the migration to AsyncStorage device-id means it is unused. Remove to reduce native footprint. Reference: /app/frontend/app.json (plugins array).

action_items: Fix app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx: change gate from `!user.profile_complete` to `!user.name` (or remove the gate entirely) so lightweight name-only onboarding actually lets the user reach the feed as the PRD requires.
Replace or remove the `<Redirect href="/login" />` fallback on line 12 of (tabs)/_layout.tsx — /login no longer exists.
Optional: remove `expo-secure-store` from app.json plugins and `firebase-admin` from backend/requirements.txt now that both are unused.
Optional cleanup: address RN web `shadow*` / `pointerEvents` deprecation warnings in the shared button/card styles.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean, well-structured, all IO async, no ObjectId leak (`_strip` drops `_id`), device-id regex correctly enforced, legacy `email_1` unique index dropped on startup, `_user_from_doc` strips obsolete Firebase fields — good hygiene.
auth.tsx: `makeId` correctly uses `crypto.getRandomValues` when available and falls back to Math.random; device id is exposed globally so api.ts can read it synchronously — pragmatic and works.
api.ts: `request` always awaits `getDeviceId()` even for public routes (auth:false path still short-circuits before setting header) — no functional issue but consider caching.
(tabs)/_layout.tsx: gate is the single point of failure for the zero-friction UX (see UI bug above).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (rewritten for device-UUID auth model — replaced Firebase-based fixtures).

success_rate.frontend: 70% (name-only onboarding->tabs flow is broken by the profile_complete gate; everything else — onboarding UI, device id gen, PATCH /auth/me, reset device, profile display without email, skip-onboarding-on-reload — works)

seed_data_creation: Test-only devices prefixed OWNER_/OTHER_/TESTDEV_ are auto-created by GET /auth/me and cleaned up in the session fixture teardown (users, groups TEST_*, messages TEST_*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and now targets the device-UUID model — reuse it. To reproduce the frontend bug: 1) open the preview URL, 2) clear localStorage, 3) reload — onboarding-screen appears, 4) enter a name and tap ENTRA — the app lands on /profile-edit?mode=onboarding instead of /(tabs). Fix is in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (see action_items). Once the main agent fixes the gate, retest: after name submit expect URL to become /(tabs) and the profile tab to show the entered name.
rca_of_issue: The Firebase→device-UUID migration replaced /login and the heavyweight onboarding, but the previously-added `if (!user.profile_complete) return <Redirect href="/profile-edit?mode=onboarding" />` guard in (tabs)/_layout.tsx was left in place. Because backend `profile_complete` is only true when name AND picture AND gender AND age are all set, this guard makes the new lightweight onboarding cosmetic — the user is always bounced into the full profile form before seeing the feed. Mitigation: relax the gate to just `!user.name` (or drop the gate and rely on the index.tsx redirect that already sends users with an empty name to /onboarding).
